playstyle.identity: Mordekaiser is a juggernaut who drags enemies into his Death Realm for 1v1s. He excels at isolating and killing key targets with his steal-their-stats ultimate.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: abilities deal AoE damage around you when active. Q slams, isolated targets take more damage. W stores damage to shield/heal. E pulls enemies toward you. R drags one enemy to Death Realm, stealing their stats. Ult the carry, 1v1 them, win.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Mordekaiser spikes at level 6 with his 1v1 ultimate. Riftmaker sustains through fights. He's strong at isolating and killing anyone.

passive.name: Darkness Rise
passive.summary: After 3 abilities/autos, deal AoE damage and gain speed.
passive.details: After damaging enemies with 3 attacks or abilities, Mordekaiser gains movement speed and deals magic damage per second around him.

abilities.name: Obliterate
abilities.summary: Slam the ground; deals more damage to isolated targets.
abilities.details: Mordekaiser slams his mace, dealing damage in an area. If it hits only one enemy champion, the damage is increased.

abilities.name: Indestructible
abilities.summary: Store damage taken; activate to shield. Reactivate to heal.
abilities.details: Mordekaiser stores damage dealt and taken. Activate to consume the store as a shield. Reactivate to consume the shield to heal.

abilities.name: Death's Grasp
abilities.summary: Pull enemies in a direction toward you.
abilities.details: Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in a target direction toward him, dealing magic damage.

abilities.name: Realm of Death
abilities.summary: Drag an enemy into Death Realm for a 1v1; steal their stats.
abilities.details: Mordekaiser banishes an enemy to Death Realm with him, stealing a portion of their stats. If they die in the realm, he keeps the stats until they respawn.
